not_implemented.A1: Inverse Turing Bench reproduction. Its 557 games are 48.9% of the corpus and biased long (90.5 vs 65.0 mean tokens); the A2-vs-A1 contrast was demoted to interval reporting. Needs its own session with the coverage bias stated.
not_implemented.A2: Classifier head on a temporally clean frozen representation model. The frozen checkpoint is still an open design decision (§19), so contrast P1 AS FROZEN is not evaluated here.

condition.name: A0-wit-nolen-capped
condition.note: CONTROL for the residual length channel that `drop_length` cannot reach: TF-IDF has no explicit length features, so dropping them is a no-op for it, yet a longer document still activates MORE terms after L2 normalisation. Truncating every witness side to a fixed token budget equalises that channel directly.

raw.evalset_policy: empty-witness games DROPPED (same set in every condition)

descriptive_top_tfidf_terms.note: fit on all of train+dev for inspection only; not used for any score

descriptive_harness_asymmetry.note: AI witnesses emitted more messages and fell silent less often. Per the Stage A inspection §10 item 6, AI turns were released with an artificial per-character delay, so message count is partly a property of the harness rather than of the writer.
